primary_endpoint: Percentage change in liver fat content measured by MRI-PDFF at week 18.
efficacy_outcome: At week 18, liver fat decreased by 28.1% with chiglitazar 48 mg and 39.5% with 64 mg, versus 3.2% with placebo; differences versus placebo were 24.9% (p<0.05) and 36.3% (p<0.001), respectively.
safety_signal: Both doses were well tolerated; most adverse events were mild to moderate.
